# What it is
The Progress Tracker shows how far you are in each course.

# What you see
Each lesson shows a tick when its steps are finished. The progress bar shows the percentage of lessons completed. You earn badges such as First Program, Sensor Pro and Line Master as you finish activities. You can only see your own progress. Your teacher sees class progress in the class dashboard.

# Passing a course
You need at least 80 percent of lessons completed and a score of at least 60 percent on the final project.
